item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"claim_1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"In both `BestOfN.forward` and `Refine.forward`, each retry attempt runs inside a fresh `with dspy.context(trace=[])`, so the candidate program is traced in a new temporary trace for that attempt.","span_ids":["span_1","span_2"]},{"claim_id":"claim_2","claim_type":"core","weight":40,"statement":"Both wrappers copy `dspy.settings.trace` immediately after the candidate module returns and before calling `reward_fn`, and they store that copied value as `best_trace`; therefore the stored attempt trace excludes any later judge or reward-function DSPy calls.","span_ids":["span_1","span_2"]},{"claim_id":"claim_3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"After scoring and selection, the wrapper merges back only `best_trace` from the chosen attempt into the outer `dspy.settings.trace`, rather than appending traces from every retry or the post-evaluation live trace.","span_ids":["span_3","span_4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"span_1","path":"dspy/predict/best_of_n.py","start_line":66,"end_line":75},{"span_id":"span_2","path":"dspy/predict/refine.py","start_line":115,"end_line":140},{"span_id":"span_3","path":"dspy/predict/best_of_n.py","start_line":74,"end_line":87},{"span_id":"span_4","path":"dspy/predict/refine.py","start_line":139,"end_line":176}]}
